Why kintools

Lean and fast

Zero dependencies, checked bundle-size numbers, no dead weight.

Type-safe by design

Paths and values are inferred from your data, not annotated by hand.

Opt-in complexity

Start with the plain primitive. Extra features are there when you reach for them, not before.

No vendor lock-in

MIT licensed, free forever. No paywalled tier to migrate away from.
